performance_case.causal_mechanism: A long-latency independent public positioning factor can increase future hypothesis diversity only if its prospective evidence clock starts early without displacing the shorter R2 mechanism screen or adding a second clock, writer, manual step or unbounded control-plane burden.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may compare only exact accepted offline CFTC source, preregistration and evaluator readiness, immutable evidence-clock requirements, sole-clock architecture rules and the frozen Manager canonical snapshot. It cannot retrieve or evaluate real reports or prices, design or implement capture, register a source, change V9, create a strategy, hypothesis, candidate or OOS, deploy, mutate canonical state, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. CFTC source activation readiness has no matched-capital strategy ledger, so predictive path risk, realized and unrealized PnL, maximum drawdown, utilization, capacity and holding age remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Activating too early could spend bounded Local, Manager and server-control-plane capacity on a lower-bound six-month evidence lane while the 14-day R2 screen is the shortest current path. Deferring too long delays an independent weekly positioning evidence clock. The audit must preserve the option with the lower proven learning-latency cost without weakening scientific or architecture gates.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly. Its value is deciding whether starting one independent prospective factor clock now has lower research opportunity cost than preserving all near-term capacity for R2, while keeping every predictive and economic claim unproved.
